scope: Three exit policies x three original costs x three already-viewed partitions; no filters, new coins, leverage or automatic promotion
entry_parity: Same source, 4H alignment, reference stop/target geometry and entry guards. Disabled target remains a reference level, never an active exit. Changed holding times alter availability of later signals.
diagnostic_features: Completed entry-source ATR/close, absolute EMA20-EMA50 gap/ATR, direction-aligned source minus previous EMA50/ATR; no future data used to classify entries
excursions: Observed MAE/MFE normalized by actual fill-to-stop distance; exit-minute extremes are censored; observed 1R is a lower-bound count, not a counterfactual executable profit
evaluation: All 2024-2025 partitions have been inspected. This study is exploratory, not a fresh holdout. Register future evaluation separately before inspecting it.
assessment: Display every policy and cost result without selecting a winner or changing live strategy-v1. Positive net expectancy, cost sensitivity, drawdown and later forward evidence must be assessed together.
